# GPT Image prompts: level map, shared parts

<!-- Generated by tool/gen_tile_prompts.dart. Edit that file and re-run instead of editing this one. -->

Parts of the level map that every region shares: the sea, the coast, the level nodes, the route and the region banner. The map is drawn by `TileMapPainter` (`lib/ui/map/tile_map.dart`) on an 8-column grid laid out in `lib/ui/map/japan_map.dart`.

- Sheets go in `assets/sprites/map/common/source/`; cut tiles are 256×256 px in `assets/sprites/map/common/`. See [README.md](README.md) for settings.
- Colours: sea `#4FA3D1`, light sea `#62B2DC`, cliff `#8A6A45`, route red `#B71C2C`, paper `#F5E6C8`, gold `#FFD54F`, outline `#4A2A1A`

## 1. Sea

Sea tiles (`.` in the band template in `japan_map.dart`), left empty in `tile_map.dart` today. sea_a/sea_b alternate; c and d are rare variants.

Text → image · `size: 1024x1024` · `background: opaque` · save as `sea_sheet.png`.

| Cell | File | Cut |
| ---- | ---- | --- |
| f1 top-left | `sea_a.png` | ground |
| f2 top-right | `sea_b.png` | ground |
| f3 bottom-left | `sea_c.png` | ground |
| f4 bottom-right | `sea_d.png` | ground |

```text
Japanese anime-style chibi mobile-game environment art, like the tile set of a cosy slice-of-life anime puzzle game. Drawn by hand by a professional 2D anime game background artist: flat cel colours with one crisp hard-edged shadow tone, thick dark-brown outline (#4A2A1A) with slight natural line-weight variation (thicker on outer silhouettes, thinner on inner details), one small flat white highlight per shiny surface, chunky rounded chibi shapes (buildings, trees, rocks and props squashed and rounded like cute toys), limited warm Japanese palette, light from the top-left. Few, deliberate details, every shape clearly readable at 64 pixels. Avoid the typical AI-art look: no airbrushed or soft gradient shading, no plastic or 3D-render sheen, no photographic texture, no texture noise, no random extra sparkles or particles, no melted or merged details, no blurry edges. No characters or people unless asked, no text, no letters, no numbers, no logo, no watermark. Outline weight matches a cartoon salmon-nigiri game icon.

Setting: a cute illustrated world map of Japan for a sushi puzzle game, seen from above like a cosy anime RPG overworld.

Tile sheet: 2x2 grid of 4 equal 512x512 cells, one item per cell, no borders, no grid lines, no gutters, no labels, no numbers. Straight top-down view, flat, no perspective. Every item at the same scale with the same outline weight. Ground tiles fill their cell edge to edge, opaque, with no outline or border round the cell; the left edge matches the right edge and the top edge matches the bottom edge so each repeats seamlessly.

Sea:
f1 (top-left) sea_a: calm sea #4FA3D1 with a few short white wave-curl strokes in a seigaiha spirit.
f2 (top-right) sea_b: the same sea a little lighter #62B2DC with the strokes in other places, so it alternates with sea_a.
f3 (bottom-left) sea_c: sea_a with one small white foam crest.
f4 (bottom-right) sea_d: sea_a with the faint dark shadow of a little fish.
```

Cut:

```bash
magick assets/sprites/map/common/source/sea_sheet.png -resize 1024x1024! -crop 512x512+0+0 +repage -resize 256x256! assets/sprites/map/common/sea_a.png
magick assets/sprites/map/common/source/sea_sheet.png -resize 1024x1024! -crop 512x512+512+0 +repage -resize 256x256! assets/sprites/map/common/sea_b.png
magick assets/sprites/map/common/source/sea_sheet.png -resize 1024x1024! -crop 512x512+0+512 +repage -resize 256x256! assets/sprites/map/common/sea_c.png
magick assets/sprites/map/common/source/sea_sheet.png -resize 1024x1024! -crop 512x512+512+512 +repage -resize 256x256! assets/sprites/map/common/sea_d.png
```
